qa1_coordinate_consistency.datum_analysis: NASA LROC reports 2,579 m based on the localized LROC NAC stereo digital terrain model derived from NAC pair M1464402633R. Our pipeline samples the NASA PDS LOLA GDR LDEM_75S_240M at 2,526.28 m relative to the standard IAU 1737.4 km reference sphere. The 52.7 m discrepancy is an expected datum and spatial resolution offset between global LOLA altimetry (240 m/px) and local high-resolution stereo photogrammetry (2-5 m/px). Critically, the pipeline uses 2,526.28 m consistently for both the observer ground level and the Horizons topocentric query (2.526 km), ensuring the observer horizon plane and celestial coordinates are rigorously colocated.
